Three.js 0.169.0 — added only for the optional Pre overlay's WebGL transition.
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.169.0/build/three.module.min.js
Project: https://threejs.org/
License: MIT (see THREE-LICENSE.txt).

This module is not loaded in the normal website experience. It is imported only
after the visitor explicitly enables the presentation layer.
The dither dissolve is an original implementation inspired by https://pear.no/.
No Pear source code, images or font files are included.
